title: Now & Then
description: Where I've been, what I've made, and what I'm up to now.
indexTitle: Where I've Been. Where I'm Going.

chapters.heading: Now
chapters.label: Now
blocks: Two things, currently: I’m in the middle of moving to Lisbon. And I’m developing a travel series called OutroSpective — asking interesting people the questions we can’t stop asking ourselves. In incredible locations.

projects.name: OutroSpective
projects.note: A travel series — interesting people, the questions we can’t stop asking ourselves, in incredible locations.

projects.name: Breakfast Club International
projects.note: Continuing to build out the Breakfast Club International site to help expand the mission, and visiting more Breakfast Clubs around the globe in the fall.

projects.name: Moving to Lisbon
projects.note: As soon as I got there, I thought to myself, “This feels more like home than, uh, home.”

projects.name: Landscape Photography
projects.note: Always a work in progress. Shooting on my Panasonic G9ii and RX100 iii.

chapters.label: 2020 · Japan → Turkey
blocks: Moved to Japan in February of 2020. We all know what happened after that. Stuck there until July, then moved to Istanbul after asking a Turkish owner at a hookah cafe in Kyoto if I could get to Turkey from Japan. “Yes,” he said.
Moved there with my buddy Rick until 2021.

chapters.label: 2021 · Turkey → LA
blocks: Moved from Turkey back to the US, and ultimately to Los Angeles because that’s where they make movies.
Filmed How to Meet People and several other short films that I’d been writing for a few years.
Loved the process, but ultimately got burnt out from pushing too hard to make new stuff.

chapters.label: 2022 · BITN, INC
blocks: After filming How to Life, a couple of my friends and I scrounged together about $150k to film a TV pilot that our buddy Michael Freeman wrote.
After a few false starts in early 2022, we finally got around to production in November of 2022.
Proud of the work we did on this. It looks incredible.

chapters.heading: 2022 – 2025
chapters.label: 2022–25 · East Hampton
blocks: East Hampton. Mostly spent recovering from burnout, rebuilding a community in the US, and planning my next big adventure.
A relatively peaceful, if not fraught, chapter.

chapters.label: 2023 · How to Life
blocks: With the help of a few Los Angeles-based producers, finally put together a trailer for How to Life that I’m incredibly proud of to this day.
Something that really reflects the spirit of creativity.

chapters.label: 2024–25 · Porsche Parlor
blocks: In 2024, my friend let me borrow his Porsche 911 for a few weeks, and I decided to create a series I’m calling Porsche Parlor.
Here’s an early cut of one of the first episodes, with director Adam Donald.

chapters.label: 2026 · The Big Map
blocks: Went on an adventure. Paris → the Netherlands → Biarritz → Utrecht for a half marathon → Milan → London → Lisbon → Istanbul → Japan.

chapters.heading: By the Numbers
chapters.label: 2026 · By the Numbers
blocks:
• 4Breakfast Clubs
  • ~12,000Miles travelled
  • 9Stops
  • 100+Çays consumed

Fell in love with a city — the move to Lisbon starts in earnest in 2027. Hundreds of cups of coffee along the way, and dinner at the best restaurant I’ve ever eaten at on planet Earth (Fifty Seconds).
Two of these turned into essays: a fall down a staircase in Istanbul airport, and three easy steps, worked out in Kyoto.

chapters.label: Yellow Satin Jacket
blocks: Building Yellow Satin Jacket. Edit by Janne Vartia.

end.title: That’s the story so far.
